## Bounded findings

The treatment group has a higher mean response than the control group in this
deterministic example.

The sensitivity result remains directionally consistent after removing the
largest observation.

```{r}
control <- c(4, 5, 6, 5, 4)
treatment <- c(7, 8, 9, 8, 10)
comparison <- data.frame(
  group = c("control", "treatment"),
  mean_response = c(mean(control), mean(treatment))
)
comparison
```

```{r}
sensitivity <- data.frame(
  full_difference = mean(treatment) - mean(control),
  trimmed_difference = mean(treatment[treatment < max(treatment)]) - mean(control)
)
sensitivity
```

## Review boundary

The statements above are deliberately small and inspectable. A structurally
linked claim means that its exact source or Artifact anchor and Evidence entry
can be opened. It does not mean that Rho has judged the scientific statement
to be true.
